messages.content: 這家企業的營收為15000美元，總成本為22000美元，回報率是多少？

function.name: investment_analysis_calculate_profit
function.description: Calculates the net profit given the total revenue and total cost Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

It says "Calculates the net profit given the total revenue and total cost". So likely net profit = (total_revenue - total_cost) * (1 - tax_rate). So we compute net profit: (15000 - 22000) * (1 - 0.2) = (-7000) * 0.8 = -5600. Then ROI = net profit / total_cost? That would be -5600/22000 = -0.2545 => -25.45%. Or ROI = net profit / total_revenue? -5600/15000 = -0.3733 => -37.33%. Which one? The question: "回報率" maybe means return rate. Usually ROI uses cost as denominator. So ROI = -25.45%. Provide answer.
